title: LottieFiles just changed the animation game
description:
LottieFiles just released an official MCP server for Claude Code that builds and edits Lottie animations from a plain-English description. No After Effects, no designer, completely free to get started. Lottie animations are tiny, razor-sharp vector animations (loaders, icons, UI micro-interactions) about 10x lighter than a GIF or MP4.

Get the full LottieFiles setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XYnKEXthgtnzhEBJeiE3s8Vt578dFWEn_flna06K9P4/edit?usp=sharing
